toml:
# Stardust sample-return capsule entry: the published case the `entry-heating` kind is checked
# against (xval/entry-stardust/PREREGISTRATION.md; tests/entry_stardust_published.rs).
#
# Entry interface at a radius of 6503.14 km, inertial 12.9 km/s at -8.2 deg, 45.8 kg, 0.811 m
# diameter, 0.2202 m nose radius (Desai et al., NASA NTRS 20050042027 and 20090004445). The
# latitude and heading are an assumed approximate entry over the Pacific; C_D is the module's
# 60 deg sphere-cone default. Published 6-DoF nominal peak deceleration: 33.4 g. The heating is
# Sutton-Graves convective only, MODELLED.
kind = "entry-heating"
body = "earth"
atmosphere = "us76"
entry_interface_altitude_m = 125003.0
velocity_frame = "inertial"
entry_speed_m_s = 12900.0
flight_path_angle_deg = 8.2
latitude_deg = 41.0
heading_deg = 100.0
mass_kg = 45.8
reference_area_m2 = 0.51657
nose_radius_m = 0.2202
drag_coefficient = 1.4828
lift_to_drag = 0.0
rotating_planet = true
step_s = 0.05
terminal_altitude_m = 10000.0
